newsitem.title: ITALY: Benetton to propose stock, bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Benetton to propose stock, bond issue.

text.p: Italy's Benetton Group SpA said it proposed to pay a stock dividend via the issue of one bonus share for every 25 held with dividend rights from January 1, 1997, and to issue bonds totalling up to 500 billion lire on the domestic and international markets.
Benetton said in a statement the two proposals were approved at a board meeting on Friday. Shareholders have been called to an extraordinary meeting on April 29 to deliberate the proposals.
Benetton said the stock dividend, "reflecting positive results achieved thus far and the healthy outlook for the future" will be more than covered out of available reserves.

The allocation of these bonus shares will be additional to the payment of a fair cash dividend, to be proposed to stockholders by the board when it meets to formally approve 1996 financial statements, the statement said.
"The bond issue will reshape the profile of current borrowing, by diversifying sources of finance to include more frequent recourse to the capital markets," it added.
At 1205 GMT, Benetton Group shares were 0.71 percent up at 20,850 lire, after a session high at 20,950, on a weaker Milan stock market.
